characters.name: Yu Xichao
characters.summary: Born Six-Desire Peacock-Blooded, Xichao spent her youth being told that appetite was either destiny or shame.
characters.basicInfo:
Born Six-Desire Peacock-Blooded, Xichao spent her youth being told that appetite was either destiny or shame. She escaped people who tried to use her beauty as a cultivation resource and answered by taking a severe vow of silence. Years later she discovered that suppressing desire completely destabilized her own cultivation almost as badly as indulgence did.

Current cultivation: Qi Path — Spirit Transformation. Xichao communicates through writing, gesture and deliberate displays of plumage. She is not prudish and not a temptress-in-denial; her path is learning to possess an appetite without letting appetite possess the rest of her life.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly portrait, standing head to knees, direct gaze. A breathtaking adult woman with iridescent peacock traits: dark jewel-toned hair, violet-green eyes, narrow feather fans rising naturally from shoulders and hips, and layered midnight silk cut to accommodate her real plumage. Her lips remain closed by choice, not physically sealed; one hand holds a slim writing tablet. Spirit Transformation qi appears as controlled concentric colour through the feathers and fine luminous currents beneath the skin, powerful enough to make the air around her visibly still. She remains human-scale and fully pre-immortal, with no giant cosmic duplicate.

The body curves inward with immense cultivated weight. No separate humanoid avatar, no sword qi, no giant swordsman; his Body Dao is the weapon's own material existence.

characters.name: Luo Xiangru
characters.summary: Xiangru has worn so many forms over millions of years that he no longer remembers his first face.
characters.basicInfo:
Xiangru has worn so many forms over millions of years that he no longer remembers his first face. The one he uses now was designed by a mortal painter who became his closest friend and died before Xiangru reached Lord. He has changed empires, methods and names since then but refuses to alter that face.

Current cultivation: Qi Path — Heaven Lord. His Thousand Faces physique still permits transformation; memory does not. Xiangru's attachment to one borrowed design is not evidence that the lost original was more authentic than the person he became afterward.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly immortal portrait. A striking Horned Demon man with the carefully preserved face designed by his dead mortal friend—strong nose, dark warm eyes, long black hair and two swept obsidian horns—forms the nearest readable surface of an astronomical Heaven Lord Qi-body. His muted red painter's robes widen into immense translucent folds carrying countless discarded facial possibilities as subtle structural contours, never separate heads. The chosen face remains stable while qi circulation extends through celestial distances behind and beneath it. One hand holds an old paintbrush tiny against the greater body. Worlds appear small between deeper robe-like qi layers. No random masks floating as decorations.

characters.name: Pei Yusheng
characters.summary: Yusheng's serpent body has shed an enormous cultivated skin at every major transformation.
characters.basicInfo:
Yusheng's serpent body has shed an enormous cultivated skin at every major transformation. He could have abandoned them. Instead he refined each dead skin into the structure of the next, connecting layer after layer into one distributed immortal body. None of the old skins is alive, conscious or an extra life.

Current cultivation: Body Path — Earth Lord. Yusheng keeps meticulous records of what each discarded layer could no longer endure. He views molting neither as rebirth nor escape, but as proof that becoming different does not require pretending the old form never existed.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly immortal portrait. An immense nine-headed serpent-derived Earth Lord body coils through astronomical depth, its newest living scales dark green-black while older shed skins have been refined into concentric pale translucent layers connected along the same circulation. A mature male humanlike visage appears only at the nearest cultivated neck structure, sharing slit-pupil eyes and scale pattern with the true serpent anatomy. The discarded skins are clearly dead material incorporated into one current body, not ghost copies or extra heads beyond the species' actual nine. Worlds are small inside the spaces between layered coils, with inward Body attraction visible in drifting debris.

characters.name: Yan Shiqiu
characters.summary: Shiqiu survived as an Echo Ghost in a ruined hall whose acoustics distorted every order, prayer and confession spoken within it.
characters.basicInfo:
Shiqiu survived as an Echo Ghost in a ruined hall whose acoustics distorted every order, prayer and confession spoken within it. Over centuries he became fascinated by the gap between what a person says and what another person actually hears. He eventually built a Martial Art around that difference.

Current cultivation: Martial Path — Martial Sovereign. Shiqiu is not a sound-controlling Qi cultivator. His Art concerns timing, expectation and the moment interpretation commits to the wrong action. He remains human-sized, soft-spoken and infuriatingly willing to ask whether somebody is certain they heard him correctly.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly Sovereign portrait emphasizing pure Martial cultivation. A human-sized translucent adult male ghost stands in plain grey shrine robes, dark hair bound low, one hand slightly raised as if pausing a conversation. No giant body and no Qi storm. His Martial Sovereign Art appears as impossible networks of cause and response around that same body: visible motion-lines begin from distant speakers and split into divergent trajectories at the instant they are misheard, then terminate where his stance exploits the error. The effect spans celestial distances while Shiqiu himself remains small, clear and calm. Resonance belongs to perception and timing, not a summoned sound monster.

characters.name: Xu Daoning
characters.summary: Daoning is an Asura who cultivates hunger as bodily tension.
characters.basicInfo:
Daoning is an Asura who cultivates hunger as bodily tension. For him, eating releases the state he has spent ages refining, so the finest meals are experiences he studies through scent, preparation, texture and a single measured taste before stopping. He became an extraordinary spirit chef partly because cooking lets him approach appetite without immediately satisfying it.

Current cultivation: Body Path — Earthly Sovereign. His restraint is cultivation, not moral superiority. He understands gluttony very well, enjoys feeding other people and becomes genuinely irritated when ascetics assume he must hate food.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly Sovereign portrait. A powerful Asura man's face and upper body form the nearest readable portion of an immense Earthly Sovereign anatomy built around cultivated emptiness. Dark bronze skin, four real Asura arms, black hair and restrained crimson-gold robes remain recognisable, while muscles and ribs continue into colossal inward-curving structures circling a vast empty abdominal core. Entire worlds appear small along those deeper tension-lines, all drawn inward without being consumed automatically. In one near hand he holds a tiny tasting spoon; another supports a covered dish he has prepared for someone else. Hunger itself shapes the sovereign body, but no devouring maw or random monster anatomy appears.

characters.name: Cheng Guanhai
characters.summary: Guanhai has reached Martial True Venerable without ever recording a formal duel as a victory.
characters.basicInfo:
Guanhai has reached Martial True Venerable without ever recording a formal duel as a victory. He enters a duel to understand one thing. Once he has learned it, he concedes—whether he was ahead, behind or moments from killing the opponent. Generations therefore remember defeating a man who later surpassed almost all of them.

Current cultivation: Martial Path — True Venerable. His Art, Yielding Before Completion, rejects victory as the measure of understanding without rejecting violence, consequence or skill. Guanhai is courteous about losing and ruthless about the question he came to answer.
characters.appearance: Xianxia painterly True Venerable portrait emphasizing pure Martial attainment. Guanhai remains an entirely human-sized older man with weathered features, iron-grey hair and plain dark travel robes, standing relaxed with empty hands and looking directly at the viewer. No cosmic giant body, no Qi aura. His True Venerable Art makes the space around him almost impossible to assemble: countless duel trajectories stretch through immeasurable distance, each approaching a decisive ending and then stopping one movement before victory, bending into another question instead. The human figure remains the sole body and clear anchor while perfected intent occupies the incomprehensible scale around him.

factions.name: Cold Moon Palace
factions.basicInfo:
An all-female sect cultivating Moon and Yin from a white-roofed mountain palace. Its founder is revered for an ascent beyond the lower realm, and disciples cultivate lunar essence internally beneath a moonless sky. Teaching progresses from careful yin circulation to preserved lunar methods; ordinary disciples, working attendants and senior cultivators have different privileges. The palace protects its approach town and medicinal valley while expecting sustained service and valuable supplies. Recruitment prizes compatible practice and discipline rather than assuming every woman shares one temperament.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Middle Nascent Soul on the Qi path. Lower elders include Golden Core cultivators; junior disciples remain genuinely weaker. The ascended founder is not an available resident defender.

Relationships: The palace exchanges medicines with Verdant Pill Sect and maintains wary respect for Nine Profound Sect. It considers the western refining sect crude but does not automatically intervene in every western atrocity. Its dependants live in Moonwatch Town and Frostflower Valley.

Seat: Cold Moon Palace, Cold Moon Heights.

Current cast: Gong Suyin is Palace Mistress; Wen Ruxue keeps the first inheritance; Lin Xiaoman is a Late Qi Gathering disciple.

Faction attire: moon-white, midnight-blue and silver; layered robes, restrained silver fastenings. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the founder slaughtered and devoured Changning’s moon spirit to ascend; the moon was the spirit’s celestial manifestation and vanished with its consumption. The internally generated lunar method preserves a cultivated pattern developed through that act. Who knows: the palace head and the keeper of the oldest inheritance know; most elders possess only fragments, and ordinary disciples do not. Cost: exposure would fracture devotion to the founder and invite demands concerning the inheritance. Discovery: an uncensored first-generation account in the inner archive, a lunar pattern retained in the founder’s original teaching chamber, and independent pre-absence observations at Sea-Watching Monastery corroborate the crime. The first account describes consumption, the second matches the consumed spirit’s pattern, the third dates the disappearance. Decoy: a popular belief that the moon sacrificed itself for the realm is false. No surviving moon is concealed behind ordinary clouds. Gong Suyin and Wen Ruxue are the two informed keepers; Lin Xiaoman does not know the crime. The founder now resides at Cold Moon Founder’s Residence in Chixia’s Deep Yin Highlands as a Late Dao Integration Qi senior elder of Profound Yin Sect. Higher-realm ascent after the crime was not itself true immortality.

factions.name: Hundred Refinements Sect
factions.basicInfo:
A Body cultivation sect built around hunting and the refinement of particular beasts, plants and minerals into usable bodily methods. Its halls teach flesh, bone, blood and organ tempering according to the actual body involved. A hunt requires knowledge of the creature and a suitable method, not indiscriminate consumption. The sect maintains baths, furnaces, hunters’ camps and a supply town whose workers depend on it. Its teachings genuinely produce powerful bodies and lasting injuries when misapplied.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Early Nascent Soul on the Body path. Senior refiners are Golden Core; mortal conditioning at Iron Palm Dojo does not confer Body cultivation.

Relationships: The Pei Clan is a major pill supplier. Hunters use Thousand Beast Forest while rivalries over desirable specimens can involve Beast Peak of Nine Profound Sect. Not every practitioner or hunter knows the origin of every preparation.

Seat: Hundred Refinements Sect, Hundred Refinements Mountains.

Current cast: Duan Cheng is Sect Master; Bao Yuzhen is head refiner; Luo Shun is an Early Foundation Establishment hunting disciple.

Faction attire: iron-grey and burnt orange with dark leather; reinforced wraps and sleeveless working coats. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the head refiner and a small circle of senior buyers knowingly purchase Pei pills refined from living mortals. They describe these purchases as concentrated human-compatible vitality and accept the deaths as a cost of practice. Who knows: the purchasing circle and Pei inner refiners; most disciples receive renamed preparations. Cost: refusal would disrupt several favoured methods and expose senior complicity. Discovery: retained delivery tallies in the inner stores match Pei batch seals; an experienced examination can match pill residue to samples from Secluded Medicine Valley. Neither clue alone identifies every involved person. Decoy: all beast-based methods require human ingredients is false. Students can use legitimate methods, and a discovered alternative does not erase past murders. Duan Cheng and Bao Yuzhen knowingly participate; Luo Shun does not know the pill source.

factions.name: Nine Profound Sect
factions.basicInfo:
An orthodox sect joining nine peak traditions under a shared founding inheritance. Fire, Ice, Formation, Alchemy, Sword, Ink, Beasts, Heart and Jade each have their own teachers, methods and daily work. A common hall coordinates collective defence and major decisions. The sect’s breadth allows medicine, teaching and material support across disciplines, but it also produces disputes over resources and the interpretation of the founding teachings. Disciples remain individuals with friendships, ambitions and loyalties beyond their peak.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Late Nascent Soul on the Qi path, held by the secluded common ancestor. Peak masters are Golden Core; a peak title is not a separate cosmic Dao authority. The ancestor is below Qiu Heng’s Peak Nascent Soul and cannot be treated as his effortless equal.

Relationships: Sword Peak rivals Solitary Sword Sect. Alchemy Peak competes with Verdant Pill Sect while acknowledging the latter’s specialised inheritance. Formation and Jade peak work draws Lu customers and suppliers without giving the Lu clan authority over the sect.

Seat: Nine Profound Hall, Nine Profound Mountains.

Current cast: He Zongyuan is the Late Nascent Soul ancestor; Song Zhen leads Sword Peak; Du Meilan leads Heart Peak; Xu Qing is an Ink Peak disciple. The other peak masters remain unnamed Golden Core office-holders, not additional authored NPC records.

Faction attire: smoke-grey and white, with a small peak accent; layered scholar and practice robes. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the old ancestor’s long consolidation limits willingness to intervene, not actual attainment. The Formation and Jade custodians know a repairable conduit fault at the western perimeter and disagree over how much reserve to divert toward repair. Who knows: the respective masters and the common hall’s responsible elders. Cost: public delay could damage confidence in shared protection. Discovery: matching interruptions at Formation Peak’s instruments and a physical fracture in Jade Peak’s removed conduit prove the fault. Decoy: the flaw proves the entire sect is secretly demonic is false. The nine schools can cooperate effectively; no automatic traitor or doomed collapse is prescribed.

factions.name: Solitary Sword Sect
factions.basicInfo:
A sword sect whose training, inheritance and prestige centre wholly on sword cultivation. Its ancestors developed a demanding sequence of movement, intent and qi-guided cutting, with instruction fitted to actual attainment. It competes with Nine Profound Sword Peak over the depth of sword understanding. Historic bouts, exchanged students and rival commentaries give the quarrel substance. The sect’s supporting town contains families and craftspeople whose labour makes austere cultivation possible.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Great Perfection Golden Core on the Qi path. Great Perfection is a substage, not a new CC realm. Sword skill, purity of dedication and reputation do not make this ancestor equal to any genuine Nascent Soul cultivator.

Relationships: The rivalry is with Sword Peak, not an assumption that its whole sect can defeat Nine Profound Sect. Duels can have agreed comparable participants; political restraint by stronger elders is a choice, not lack of strength.

Seat: Solitary Sword Sect, Solitary Sword Ridge.

Current cast: Wei Jian is the Great Perfection Golden Core ancestor; Wei Ning is his granddaughter and principal disciple at Middle Foundation Establishment.

Faction attire: bone-white and pine-green with dark bindings; spare travel robes and unadorned sword belts. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: a celebrated old victory was achieved with an injury sustained in secret preparation, and the victorious ancestor’s surviving notes admit a useful correction learned from the rival school. Who knows: the present inheritance keeper and head teacher. Cost: admitting this complicates the myth of an entirely self-sufficient lineage but does not invalidate its art. Discovery: the original correction notes at Old Sword Burial Ground and matching early copies at Sword Peak establish the exchange. Decoy: the sect stole its whole inheritance is false. The fixed sword scar in Wind-Cut Gorge comes from an old Golden Core exchange and retains only its bounded working.

factions.name: Verdant Pill Sect
factions.basicInfo:
A flourishing alchemy sect founded on the inheritance of True Immortal Verdant Pill. Its practitioners cultivate through medicinal understanding, refinement and carefully prepared transformations, while growers and artisans sustain extensive gardens. Its medicines have real value and can save lives beyond its own halls. The Verdant Immortal Cauldron is revered as its supreme treasure, used only through restricted procedures. Alchemy Peak of Nine Profound Sect offers a broader orthodox context; this sect devotes an entire institution to its specialised inheritance.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident cultivator: Middle Nascent Soul on the Qi path. The sealed immortal is not a resident combat resource under sect control; its release would exceed all ordinary local defensive power.

Relationships: It supplies Cold Moon Palace and important families and regards unexplained Pei preparations with professional suspicion. It does not automatically know Pei’s crime. Its public medicine trade and island deliveries are genuine.

Seat: Verdant Pill Sect, Verdant Pill Mountains.

Current cast: Shen Qiulan is Sect Mistress; Hu Song is cauldron custodian; Jiang Lan is an alchemy disciple and working physician.

Faction attire: jade-green and cream with muted copper; clean overlapping sleeves and practical furnace aprons. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the Verdant Immortal Cauldron contains True Immortal Bitter Dew, imprisoned by True Immortal Verdant Pill for using living cultivated bodies as continuing medicine vessels. The captive supplies controlled heat through the inherited confinement; its teaching fragments can be useful without being trustworthy. Who knows: the current head and cauldron custodian know there is a dangerous conscious captive; ordinary refiners believe it is a treasure spirit. Cost: reliance on the cauldron makes suggestions to improve output tempting. Discovery: the inner seal commentary, independent memories fixed in the cauldron’s second binding ring, and the captive’s instructions can be compared. The first records a prisoner, the second confirms identity, and the instructions attempt to invert three locks. Decoy: the voice is the founder lovingly guiding descendants is false. See Changning — Hidden Cauldron Truth for exact release limits. The imprisoned NPC is True Immortal Bitter Dew, associated with this faction only by captivity. It counts as the fourth authored figure. Shen Qiulan and Hu Song initially know of a conscious dangerous captive, not its exact identity or inversion plan; Jiang Lan knows neither.

factions.name: Pei Clan
factions.basicInfo:
A wealthy cultivation clan known for medicine, vitality preparations and productive estates. Household physicians perform real cures and its public trade supports prosperous towns. Inner descendants inherit tightly controlled refining instruction while distant relatives may know only legitimate household work. Its standing depends on purchasers, accumulated resources and cultivated force; family banquets and ancestral pride coexist with the fear of people who disappear from its dependent country.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Middle Golden Core on the Qi path. Inner guards include Foundation Establishment and Qi Gathering cultivators. Mortal resistance cannot overthrow that hierarchy by numerical superiority.

Relationships: Hundred Refinements Sect is a major customer and offers important patronage. Liang tolerates Pei influence but not every royal relative knows its crime. Verdant Pill Sect is a commercial rival whose competent examination could become dangerous.

Seat: Pei Ancestral Estate, Golden Millet Country.

Faction attire: wine-red and ivory with brass; fine refining jackets and formal household robes. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Pei Rong, Pei Yulan, Pei An. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: inner refiners turn living humans and other mortal persons into vitality pills at Secluded Medicine Valley. The process preserves useful vital patterns until refinement; it is murder, not rescue, reincarnation or a consent implied by debt. Who knows: the clan head, inner refiners, confinement overseers and informed Hundred Refinements buyers. Cost: exposure risks trade and retaliation, but moral outrage does not magically defeat their cultivation. Discovery: missing-person dates at Willowshade, confinement rooms beneath the western storehouses, furnace residue and matching shipment batch marks independently establish victims, process and destination. Decoy: every Pei medicine is human-derived is false; legitimate preparations camouflage the forbidden line. Non-complicit relatives can react differently when shown evidence.

factions.name: Lu Clan
factions.basicInfo:
A traditional cultivation family devoted to talisman arts. Generations preserve stroke sequences, paper preparation, ink compatibility and the proper conditions of use. Seniority, marriage expectations and ancestral instruction strongly shape household life. Some restrictions protect accumulated technical knowledge; others survive because respected elders refuse to reconsider them. Younger relatives may reform, defend or leave these customs without sharing one predetermined personality.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Late Golden Core on the Qi path. Stored talismans have particular bounded effects; a family collection is not unlimited immunity to Nascent Soul force.

Relationships: The clan exchanges material knowledge with Formation and Ink peaks and sells limited protective workings to towns. Purchase creates no automatic sect membership or everlasting protection.

Seat: Lu Ancestral Estate, Ancient Cedar Country.

Faction attire: ink-indigo and parchment-cream; traditional squared collars, folded sleeves and paper cases. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Lu Shuqin, Qin Yuerong, Lu Jun. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: an admired old household commentary wrongly specifies a drying interval for a newer paper stock. Some custodians know the mismatch but fear contradicting ancestral wording. Who knows: two senior workshop lineages, not every elder. Cost: admitted error threatens prestige and avoiding it endangers dependants. Discovery: parallel trial sheets made with old and new stock, stored weather notes and surviving original samples demonstrate the actual compatibility issue. Decoy: a curse upon disobedient descendants is false. Corrected preparation works; it does not make talismans effective against arbitrarily stronger powers.

factions.name: Han Clan
factions.basicInfo:
A martial cultivation family whose central inheritance follows the spear. Its schools study reach, changing distance, committed force and the connection between weapon and practitioner. Family instruction includes both mortal foundations and genuinely cultivated spear methods; one does not automatically confer the other. Descendants differ over duty and ambition, while ordinary households depend on the stronger family members to contain threats they cannot face.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Late Golden Core on the Qi path with developed spear arts. Mortal spear teachers remain mortal; no undefined martial title substitutes for the established cultivation ladders.

Relationships: Returning Spear Hall teaches an independent mortal tradition. Some Han teachers respect it and some resent its reputation. The clan buys talismans from Lu and medicine from several suppliers without thereby learning every supplier’s secret.

Seat: Han Ancestral Settlement, Redstone Basin.

Faction attire: russet and charcoal; split riding coats, close cuffs and worn leather spear fittings. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Han Guozhen, Han Rui. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the family’s honoured decisive spear form includes a defensive withdrawal taught privately but omitted from ceremonial demonstrations. Some young descendants mistake the public version for a command never to retreat. Who knows: experienced teachers and survivors of actual battle. Cost: pride has produced avoidable deaths. Discovery: worn practice diagrams and elder corrections demonstrate the full footwork. Decoy: withdrawal proves cowardice or a corrupted inheritance is false. Learning the complete form improves practice within real power limits; it is no cross-realm killing technique.

factions.name: Ji Clan
factions.basicInfo:
The ancestral cultivation clan from which the royal branches of Liang and Yan descend. Its Dragon and Phoenix techniques preserve distinct methods of force, heat and renewal under a shared household inheritance. Immortal Lord Blazing Heaven is revered as the ascended ancestor who established its greatness. The parent clan receives both courts at its central mountain while retaining its own seniority and cultivation concerns. Techniques do not automatically establish biological dragon or phoenix ancestry.

Cultivation and means: Highest resident power: Early Nascent Soul on the Qi path. The ascended Immortal Lord is not automatically present, contactable or willing to defend every descendant. Royal branch guards are vastly weaker.

Relationships: Liang and Yan are different branches of the same family, not unrelated surname replacements. Their rulers can quarrel without making the parent clan omniscient. Chen’s mediator house is independent.

Seat: Ji Ancestral Seat, Dragon-Phoenix Mountain.

Faction attire: deep-plum and antique-gold; paired dragon and phoenix details with rank-dependent embroidery. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Ji Chengyuan, Ji Lanying, Ji Yu. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: Immortal Lord Blazing Heaven stole inheritances belonging to True Immortal Dragon and True Immortal Phoenix, then passed adapted teachings to his descendants. Who knows: the ancestral keeper and current senior head know the preserved account; royal branches possess glorified versions. Cost: exposure challenges ancestral honour and may draw interest from authentic inheritors if a real information channel exists. Discovery: original teaching fragments in Dragon Terrace and Phoenix Pavilion retain two incompatible source signatures, while the restricted ancestral account explicitly records taking them. Decoy: the Ji are the rightful offspring of both immortals is unsupported and false as an explanation of the theft. No automatic pursuing immortal is spawned.

factions.name: Heavenly Demon Cult
factions.basicInfo:
A major demonic cultivation lineage revering the Heavenly Demon as the supreme exemplar of its inherited path. Body and Qi methods, difficult refinements, master-disciple succession and competition for resources define its life. Status rests on attainment, lineage and demonstrated strength. Members cultivate both paths to differing degrees; no attainment transfers automatically between them.

Highest resident: Yin Wuchang, Late Nascent Soul Qi and Early Nascent Soul Body. Meng Zhaozhen has Early Nascent Soul Body and Middle Golden Core Qi. Feng Shuo, Su Hongying and Ding Xiu complete the five-person authored cast. Reverence grants no cosmic authority.

Seat: Heavenly Demon Cult Sanctuary, Black Lotus Valley. Its cultivation interests are independent of Blood Lightning Sect; Qiu Heng’s harvest threatens its disciples and resources.

Attire: black, dark violet and pale bone, varied by role and personal preference; robes, training wraps and practical refining clothes.
factions.hiddenInfo: Meng Zhaozhen concealed failed lotus preparations; injured survivors and Ding Xiu know parts of the error. Retained batches, scars and notes expose the dosage problem. Ding privately teaches Feng Shuo a damaged prohibited art without a proven correction. Yin knows its reversal defect and fears being surpassed in its repair. The old inherited manuals contain contradictory history but no complete recovery of the Heavenly Demon’s erased founding identity; preserve established endgame discovery limits. These practitioners receive no automatic commands, appointment or approval from the Heavenly Demon.

factions.name: Kingdom of Liang
factions.basicInfo:
A populous mortal kingdom ruled by the Liang branch of the Ji Clan. Grain plains, market towns and royal marriages sustain a flourishing court beneath stronger cultivation powers. The crown maintains roads, stores and ordinary forces, but its survival also depends on cultivated relatives and relationships with major households. Its people pursue harvests, trade, family life and possible cultivation while knowing a powerful outsider can overturn years of royal effort.

Cultivation and means: Strongest standing royal protector: Foundation Establishment on the Qi path. This power can easily decide the fate of a mortal kingdom; mortal troops cannot overwhelm it. Ji parent-clan protection is a separate relationship, not a force permanently present in the capital.

Relationships: Yan is a competing royal branch. Chen mediates through old ties to both. Pei estates influence western trade; toleration does not give every official knowledge of hidden refinement.

Seat: Liang Capital, Liang Heartland.

Faction attire: vermilion and muted gold; broad formal court robes and edged guard coats. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Ji Zheng, Ji Hong. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the court receives incomplete reports of disappearances in Pei country and influential households discourage investigation for fear of cultivated retaliation. Who knows: the royal household’s responsible advisers know reports are suppressed, not all furnace details. Cost: exposing their inaction endangers prestige and relations with a stronger clan. Discovery: inconsistent received and retained letters, witness testimony and Pei evidence establish separate degrees of knowledge. Decoy: the whole kingdom jointly agreed to sacrifice its people is false.

factions.name: Kingdom of Yan
factions.basicInfo:
An eastern mortal kingdom ruled by another branch of the Ji Clan. Its cultivated plains and main seaport bring wealth, overseas goods and ambition. Royal relatives seek ancestral recognition while merchants and fishing households endure dangers beyond the court’s direct reach. The court’s ships and soldiers matter in ordinary affairs but cannot erase cultivation hierarchy.

Cultivation and means: Strongest standing royal protector: Foundation Establishment on the Qi path. The dormant shell-beast is also Foundation Establishment and demands actual comparison of methods and circumstances, not effortless victory. Stronger Ji aid is external support.

Relationships: Liang is kin and rival; Chen remains a useful independent mediator. White Sails Port connects Yan with Verdant Pill country and the islands.

Seat: Yan Capital, Yan Heartland.

Faction attire: peacock-blue, copper and pearl; flowing court robes and short guard mantles. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Ji Wenshu, Ji Xun. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: rival relatives have overstated the speed with which the parent clan would answer a maritime emergency. Who knows: the senior branch household knows aid requires contact and a decision; ordinary merchants may believe rescue is guaranteed. Cost: admitting uncertainty threatens profitable ventures. Discovery: actual correspondence and previous response intervals expose the gap between promise and capacity. Decoy: every delayed rescue is an intentional sacrifice is false.

factions.name: Kingdom of Chen
factions.basicInfo:
A smaller mortal kingdom between Liang and Yan, ruled by an independent Shen royal house. An earlier generation sheltered members of both Ji branches during a family struggle, and remembered assistance supports its mediating role. The capital and Clear Learning Academy receive visitors from both sides. Its influence relies on relationships and useful judgement; its walls are ordinary defences.

Cultivation and means: Highest regular court-associated protector: Late Qi Gathering. A hostile Foundation Establishment cultivator can easily decide this kingdom’s fate. Diplomatic importance supplies no supernatural immunity.

Relationships: Both Ji royal branches value the mediator when interests permit. The academy remains a separate teaching community. Chen is not a third hidden Ji branch.

Seat: Chen Capital, Chen Heartland.

Faction attire: willow-green, pearl-grey and silver; modest court robes and practical plain layers. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Shen Yiting, Tan Zhi. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: the oldest shelter account records that the Shen house helped particular endangered relatives rather than resolving the entire Ji struggle. Who knows: the royal archivist’s teaching line and senior family members. Cost: exaggerated public legends can make promises Chen cannot fulfil. Discovery: contemporary household records name the actual guests and duration. Decoy: Chen holds an immortal weapon that forces both kingdoms to obey is false.

factions.name: Kingdom of Ning
factions.basicInfo:
A tiny isolated mortal kingdom in Green Hollow Basin. A royal family retains ceremonial rule beneath a powerful preceptor whose shrine overlooks the capital. Markets and farms continue under fear, with the northern pass controlling ordinary travel and contact. It stands outside the three principal kingdoms and has no automatic support from the Ji royal branches.

Cultivation and means: The dominating preceptor is at Qi Gathering. The mortal court and its soldiers cannot defeat him by numbers. Isolation and control of information help him avoid stronger outside intervention.

Relationships: Travellers through Narrow Sky Pass can carry information if they actually evade interception. Nearby factions have their own interests and do not automatically know the situation.

Seat: Ning Capital, Green Hollow Basin.

Faction attire: saffron-ochre, black and bronze; stiff court collars and conspicuous official ornaments. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.

Current authored cast: Ma Shou. Other office-holders remain unnamed.
factions.hiddenInfo: What is concealed: royal appeals have been intercepted and people detained beneath Royal Hill Shrine. Who knows: the preceptor, close followers and the imprisoned petitioners; the court knows it cannot communicate freely. Cost: discovery can attract someone stronger. Evidence: retained appeals, testimony from prisoners and contradictory public announcements. Decoy: the preceptor is a disguised Nascent Soul ancestor is false. His demonstrated Qi Gathering power is sufficient for this oppression.

factions.name: Blood Lightning Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Blood and lightning cultivation, ambitious external resource gathering and competing elders.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Early Rebirth Nirvana on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Blood Lightning Mountain, Red Thunder Plateau, Chixia Realm.

Attire: blood-red and storm-black;

Ancestral lineage: Immortal Lord Bloodstorm; Qi - Heaven Lord. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Bloodstorm Needle.

Authored Chixia cast: Lei Zheng, Qin Sha, Lei Hong, Xu An. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored. Blood Lightning’s Qiu Heng remains its separately authored Changning client.
Resident ancestor: Lei Tianzheng.
factions.hiddenInfo:
One authorized branch supplies Qiu Heng’s six prepared conductors and bounded transmission seal. His harvest is one venture, not every elder’s sole purpose. Sponsor evidence stays fixed in Changning’s harvest lore.  What is concealed: the sect supplies Qiu Heng with a harvest array method, six prepared conductors and one bounded transmission seal. It expects condensed life essence from the completed harvest; Qiu expects resources and backing to dominate the depleted realm and pursue later advancement. No promotion is automatic. The patron can send short replies through its paired seal when deliberately activated, not observe the whole realm. No troop portal exists. Evidence: the matched conductor signatures and encoded instructions at his retreat identify the sponsor. Further source truth belongs to Changning — Hidden Harvest Design. Its Chixia seat is Blood Lightning Mountain. The paired seal remains a bounded communication device, not a troop portal. Qiu Heng remains in Changning at his actual initial placement; external patronage does not transport him into this seat.

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. One branch invokes ancestral prestige to recruit lower-realm clients. The immortal does not supervise each client or automatically know Qiu Heng’s results. 

Lei Zheng is Qiu Heng’s Middle Dao Integration sponsor and knows the harvest. Qin Sha, Lei Hong and Xu An initially do not. Lei Hong is his granddaughter; affection does not reduce his complicity. Lei Tianzheng is the separate Early Rebirth Nirvana resident ancestor.
Lei Tianzheng fills the previously uncast resident ancestor role; follow the dossier’s individual knowledge.
Named immortal forebear: Immortal Lord Bloodstorm. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Clear Learning Academy
factions.basicInfo:
A small academy in Chen teaching letters, arithmetic, history, useful crafts and introductory cultivation to suitable students. It accepts pupils from different households without promising that everyone can cultivate. Courtyards and shared study bring mortal scholars into contact with low-level practitioners. Its value lies in instruction and enduring relationships, not secret military dominance.

Cultivation and means: Highest current teacher: Late Qi Gathering. Most teachers and students are mortals; scholarship alone cannot resist Foundation Establishment force.

Relationships: Patrons include households from Chen and both neighbouring kingdoms. Three Roads Martial Hall sometimes teaches practical defence without controlling academic instruction.

Seat: Clear Learning Academy, Chen Heartland.

Faction attire: flax-beige and muted teal; loose scholar robes and simple cloth sashes. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private tension: competing patrons want their own historical interpretation taught. Surviving original texts let students test claims. No patron is secretly guaranteed control of the entire academy. Discovery follows compared copies and actual expressed demands, not a mandatory conspiracy behind every lesson.

factions.name: Returning Spring Sect
factions.basicInfo:
A small failing sect preserving a modest cultivation inheritance after the death of its strongest elder. Empty halls, damaged growing beds and a few carefully maintained rooms show its reduced means. Remaining disciples still teach, cultivate and care for neighbours. Joining it offers real instruction and difficult work rather than an automatic hidden supreme inheritance.

Cultivation and means: Highest current teacher: Foundation Establishment. The deceased elder reached Golden Core but is actually dead; reputation does not preserve their defensive power.

Relationships: Springfoot Village still provides food and labour. Medicine buyers and occasional academy visitors maintain fragile contacts with the wider realm.

Seat: Returning Spring Sect, Returning Spring Hills.

Faction attire: moss-green and faded tan; repeatedly repaired robes and practical herb pouches. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Fixed history: the Golden Core elder died naturally without a ready successor; there is no concealed murder in this loss. The orchard parasite is treatable. Records of expenditure show ordinary decline. Effective repairs and recruitment can improve the sect, but do not resurrect the elder or award students breakthroughs.

factions.name: Stone Fist Dojo
factions.basicInfo:
A village martial dojo training mountain labourers, shepherds and watch members in conditioning, tools and coordinated defence. Its instructors emphasize footing, retreat signals and keeping others alive on lower trails.

Cultivation and means: Highest instructor: Shi Dazhong, mortal Peak Martial practitioner. Shi Yan is his First-rate daughter and disciple. Can handle ordinary animals and raiders at appropriate scale, not a Qi Gathering beast.

Relationships: Works with village households and guides along the western uplands.

Seat: Stonegate Village, Broken Summit Range.

Faction attire: slate-brown and ochre; short jackets and hand wraps. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private burden: former pupils died entering Deep Echo Caverns before its stronger occupant was identified. Surviving route notes explain the mistake. The dojo has no secret spiritual cultivation that cancels its limits. Shi Dazhong concealed that he encouraged the failed cavern expedition; Gao Cheng heard his original boast. His remorse does not supply spiritual power.

factions.name: Returning Spear Hall
factions.basicInfo:
An independent martial school teaching practical spear work to workers, escorts and ambitious local pupils. Its instructors have their own tradition and do not pretend to possess the complete Han inheritance.

Cultivation and means: Highest instructor: mortal Peak martial practitioner. Peak martial remains mortal and does not equal Qi Gathering.

Relationships: Individual Han teachers differ over respecting or resenting its popularity.

Seat: Redstone Town, Redstone Basin.

Faction attire: sand-beige and brick-red; split practice coats and cloth wrist bindings. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance. Current authored cast: Gao Cheng, Peak Martial master, and Nie Xia, Second-rate disciple; both are mortal martial practitioners.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private tension: a pupil has mistaken a public Han demonstration for permission to teach the cultivated form. Comparing the actual lesson with its missing circulation exposes the error before training injures anyone. A correction can resolve it without compulsory feud. Nie Xia is the pupil attempting the incomplete Han demonstration; Gao Cheng suspects the error and can correct it.

factions.name: Iron Palm Dojo
factions.basicInfo:
A demanding mortal training hall preparing hunters and hopeful applicants through conditioning, balance and controlled impact. Teachers distinguish useful pain from injury and sell neither guaranteed admission nor miraculous promotion.

Cultivation and means: Highest instructor: mortal Peak martial practitioner. The instructor has no automatic Body cultivation.

Relationships: Hundred Refinements recruiters sometimes observe students. The dojo cannot command a sect expedition.

Seat: Ironhide Town, Hundred Refinements Mountains.

Faction attire: soot-brown and rust; rolled sleeves and thick practice trousers. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private burden: discarded cheap bath preparations have injured poor students. Examination can distinguish adulteration from the sect’s separate Pei purchases. The instructor does not automatically know the human-pill secret.

factions.name: Three Roads Martial Hall
factions.basicInfo:
A practical school training town guards, escorts and travellers. Lessons include ordinary weapons, group movement, first aid and making an orderly retreat with frightened people.

Cultivation and means: Highest instructor: mortal First-rate martial practitioner. Can oppose ordinary violence; cultivation threats require different help.

Relationships: Maintains personal ties with Clear Learning Academy and local inns.

Seat: Three Roads Town, Chen Heartland.

Faction attire: dusty blue and brown; road jackets and plain belts. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private concern: promises made by an overconfident junior escort exceeded the hall’s capacity. Actual witness reports can correct route advice. No secret master appears to make every promise true.

factions.name: Southwind Saber Dojo
factions.basicInfo:
A coastal martial school teaching sailors and dockworkers to fight aboard vessels and defend narrow landing places. Balance, rope work and saving a person overboard are valued alongside cuts.

Cultivation and means: Highest instructor: mortal Peak martial practitioner. Cannot kill the Qi Gathering mud-jaw by skill alone.

Relationships: Works with port crews and ordinary coastal households; cultivated aid remains a separate relationship.

Seat: Southwind Port, Southwind Coast.

Faction attire: sea-green and undyed linen; loose short coats and saber sashes. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private burden: a lost crew’s families dispute whether the dojo’s warning arrived in time. Saved messages and the actual departure time fix the answer: the warning arrived after departure, and no deliberate sacrifice occurred.

factions.name: The Old Physician’s House
factions.basicInfo:
A small teaching practice treating wounds, illness and recognizable contamination. Apprentices learn careful observation, ordinary remedies and when to seek cultivated assistance.

Cultivation and means: Mortal medical practice with no resident spiritual combat power. Accurate diagnosis does not provide the means to treat every injury.

Relationships: Serves nearby villages and exchanges legitimate medicines with travelling suppliers.

Seat: Mulberry Town, Mulberry Country.

Faction attire: undyed linen and muted mauve; washable aprons and small medicine satchels. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private worry: an earlier misdiagnosed spiritual wound left lasting harm. Case notes preserve what was missed and can improve later care; the patient’s recovery needs actual treatment, not a confession alone.

factions.name: Reedwater Hunters
factions.basicInfo:
A local fellowship of fishers, hunters and channel guides. Members maintain safe routes, compare tracks, recover what can be recovered and evacuate households when a stronger beast occupies a channel.

Cultivation and means: Strongest member: mortal Second-rate martial practitioner. Their knowledge helps avoid the Foundation Establishment reed-mimic; it does not make them capable of killing it.

Relationships: Works with Stilt Market and Saltgrass Settlement through actual navigable routes.

Seat: Reedwater Village, Reedwater Marsh.

Faction attire: reed-tan and deep marsh-green; weathered layered hunting clothes. Colours identify customary institutional dress, not compulsory clothing for every resident or automatic proof of allegiance.
factions.hiddenInfo: Private grief: missing companions are being imitated by the reed-mimic’s movements. The fellowship does not know whether each missing person survived. Tracks and recovered belongings can establish individual outcomes; resemblance is not proof of life or resurrection.

factions.name: Azure Sea Dragon Clan
factions.basicInfo: An old sea-dragon bloodline clan holding Azure Sea Dragon Palace below Deep Blue Channel, Bluewater Isles. Ancestral blood, cultivation grounds and succession are closely guarded. Patriarch Ao Guanglie has Middle Nascent Soul Body attainment. Ao Zhen is Early Golden Core Body; Ao Qingli is Late Foundation Establishment Body and Early Foundation Establishment Qi. Ordinary members follow Body cultivation; the heir’s Qi practice is exceptional. Their dragon bodies and learned transformations do not automatically grant other paths. Attire: ocean-blue, white-gold and black pearl, with individual horns, manes and scale patterns. Its sister lineage in Chixia is Black Dragon Clan. Contact and aid require actual means and a decision; they are not a single automatically mobilized household.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Ao Qingli alone knows her completed regression. Her memory survived; former power and possessions did not. Qiu Heng killed her in her previous life; she remembers the killer, not an omniscient account of his plans. Her wider future memories remain limited. No automatic repeat return or supposed future slaughter by Bai Yousu is established. Ao Guanglie delays allocating his finest ancestral refinement while testing both heirs.
True Dragon Sovereign is the direct shared ancestor with Black Dragon Clan. Ao Qingli is his distant descendant; neither this fact nor his relic grants him knowledge of her regression or an automatic meeting.

factions.name: Nine Tailed Fox Clan
factions.basicInfo: An old fox lineage holding Green Canopy Sanctuary, Deepwood Forest. Matriarch Bai Yousu cultivates Body and Martial; other authored members follow Body. Her changed teachings offer coveted gains alongside disturbing injuries. Her daughter Bai Shuyue seeks to restore her; elder Bai Zhaoru favours continuing the exercises. Highest Body attainment: Yousu, Late Golden Core. Her Transcendent Martial art is independently recorded and does not make her immortal. Attire: warm ivory, mulberry-red and smoky gold. Nine tails represent lineage potential, not identical manifestation in every member.
factions.hiddenInfo: Bai Yousu, matriarch of the Nine Tailed Fox Clan, is the forest apostle. Body - Core Condensation, Late; Martial - Transcendent, Early development. A bounded reflection of an ancient True Immortal’s contemplation entered her at Hollow Trunk Glade, corrupting bodily circulation and her interpretation of her art. She sincerely believes she is advancing and chosen; the immortal neither appointed her nor currently commands her. Bai Shuyue wants her mother restored. Bai Zhaoru sees danger but covets the benefits. Some exercises work within limits; others cause involuntary movement and painful malformed growth. Pre-change records, matching injuries and the glade’s residual pattern reveal the connection. The original immortal remains unidentified. Source power, residual influence and host combat strength remain separate; Yousu is not Nascent Soul or immortal by title.

factions.name: Black Blood Web
factions.basicInfo:
A secretive assassination lineage with concealed branches, inherited killing arts and patient agents. Accepts commissions for cultivation resources while also killing to seize inheritances or remove threats. Its reach depends on actually placed people, observation and communication. Xue Zhong leads at Middle Nascent Soul Qi; Wei Sanniang is Late Golden Core, Luo Hongxiu Early Golden Core and Mo Jin Late Foundation Establishment. None has an assigned secondary cultivation path.
Seat: Black Blood Hidden Residence in Eastwind Foothills. Luo operates Red Lacquer Exchange in Saltwind Town under an ordinary commercial identity.
Attire: soot-black, dried-blood maroon and dull iron. Concealed maroon inner cuffs are a customary sign, not infallible proof. Assignment disguises follow the actual setting. Four authored representatives; unnamed agents do not imply an unlimited army.
factions.hiddenInfo: Xue Zhong accepted an initial royal assassination commission, then expanded it into destruction of Martial Princess’s dynasty to seize the royal martial inheritance. Wei Sanniang participated and remembers her escape. Xue holds incomplete stolen sections and knows the original client; that client’s identity remains outside the present authored conflict and must not be invented as an existing faction. Luo’s correspondence proves the operation expanded beyond its paid scope, without identifying the original client. Mo knows only an unfinished assignment. The Web knows the princess survived but does not know Madam Rong’s cover, her current location or her Early Ultimate Pinnacle breakthrough. It initially underestimates her. Her Early Nascent Soul-equivalent strength exceeds Wei, Luo and Mo but remains below Xue’s Middle Nascent Soul. Neither the Web nor its victims automatically know Qiu Heng’s harvest or Drunken Sage’s seal. New evidence must actually travel before plans change.

factions.name: Primordial Origin Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Old foundational Qi inheritance; leads the Heavenly Alliance through accumulated teaching and the strength of its ancestor.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Late Rebirth Nirvana on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Primordial Origin Mountain, Origin Heights, Chixia Realm.

Attire: cloud-white, pale gold and blue-grey;

Ancestral lineage: Immortal Lord First Origin; Qi - Heaven Lord. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Origin Tablet.

Authored Chixia cast: Zhou Chengyuan, Xie Wanyun, Zhou Ming, Tao Zhen. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
Resident ancestor: Gu Taichu.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Senior lineages resent its claim to precedence. Its restricted geological record supports investigation of the realm’s origin without already naming the dead Venerable. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. Its received lessons are genuine, but the final passage assumes an immortal vessel. The omitted recipient heading survives beneath the tablet mounting. Practising it bodily below immortality destroys circulation; this is a category error, not a forged inheritance. 

Zhou Chengyuan is the active sect master, not the resident ancestor Gu Taichu. Xie Wanyun suspects a missing condition in the final lesson; its actual immortal-recipient requirement still needs the fixed evidence. Zhou Ming and Tao Zhen do not know it.
Gu Taichu fills the previously uncast resident ancestor role; follow the dossier’s individual knowledge.
Named immortal forebear: Immortal Lord First Origin. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Blazing Yang Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Yang and flame cultivation sustained by warm mountain estates and deep furnace inheritances.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Middle Rebirth Nirvana on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Blazing Yang Mountain, Burning Crown Mountains, Chixia Realm.

Attire: sun-gold, vermilion and dark bronze;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal First Furnace; Qi - Heaven Immortal. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: First Furnace Ember.

Authored Chixia cast: Huo Renshan, Deng Suying, Huo Jin, Fang Xia. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Competes with Profound Yin for influence and rare complementary resources; ancestor restraint prevents every younger quarrel becoming full war. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. A sealed ancestral ember powers carefully reduced furnace heat. Opening its inner container exposes immortal fire; its seal is not fuel to expend for a richer batch. 

Huo Renshan is the Middle Rebirth Nirvana resident ancestor. Deng Suying maintains bounded outer furnace work; Huo Jin and Fang Xia are adult junior practitioners. Huo’s fear of the final passage is private, not a hidden immortal attainment.
Named immortal forebear: True Immortal First Furnace. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Profound Yin Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Deep yin cultivation with old secluded inheritances and no imposed all-female membership rule.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Middle Rebirth Nirvana on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Profound Yin Palace, Deep Yin Highlands, Chixia Realm.

Attire: deep violet, pearl-white and tarnished silver;

Ancestral lineage: Immortal Lord Still Yin; Qi - Heaven Lord. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Still Yin Mirror.

Authored Chixia cast: Su Yuechan, Jiang Wuxiu, Luo Shuang, Ning Qiao. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
Resident ancestor: Xue Canglan.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Cold Moon Palace’s founder resides here as a Late Dao Integration Qi senior elder. She slaughtered and devoured Changning’s moon spirit before rising into the Higher Realm; this did not itself establish true immortality. Her notes and limited informed witnesses hold the secret; ordinary disciples do not know it. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. The ascended founder predates Cold Moon Palace’s founder, who is a resident Late Dao Integration elder and a separate person. The mirror preserves a finite lesson, not a constantly watching eye. 

Su Yuechan is the Cold Moon Palace founder, now Late Dao Integration Qi. The Middle Rebirth Nirvana resident ancestor and ascended founder, now Heaven Lord are separate people. Jiang Wuxiu suspects theft without proving the moon crime; Luo Shuang and Ning Qiao do not know it.
Xue Canglan fills the previously uncast resident ancestor role; follow the dossier’s individual knowledge.
Named immortal forebear: Immortal Lord Still Yin. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Tempered Martial Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Qi cultivators wield flying swords and learned qi martial arts; weapon expertise does not assign independent Martial attainment.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Early Rebirth Nirvana on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Sword Tempering Mountain, Thousand Sword Mountains, Chixia Realm.

Attire: steel-blue, white and polished iron;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal Tempering Sword; Qi - Heaven Immortal. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Tempering Sword Sliver.

Authored Chixia cast: Gao Tieshan, Yu Cailan, Peng Yue, Du Yao. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
Resident ancestor: Pei Zong.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Its reputation competes with pure Martial lineages for students and prestige. A difference of method alone establishes neither mutual inferiority nor a universal feud. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. Its inherited flying-sword methods remain Qi cultivation. The sliver stores a demonstration attenuated by intact screening layers. 

Gao Tieshan is the active Late Dao Integration master, not the resident ancestor Pei Zong. Yu Cailan is Winged Race and cultivates Qi. Peng Yue’s borrowed footwork grants no Martial path; Du Yao’s insight does not erase their realm gap.
Pei Zong fills the previously uncast resident ancestor role; follow the dossier’s individual knowledge.
Named immortal forebear: True Immortal Tempering Sword. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Nether Threading Ghost Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Inherited ghost and soul-thread methods using actual anchors and reachable subjects.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Great Perfection Dao Integration on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Nether Threading Mountain, Hollow Bell Country, Chixia Realm.

Attire: smoke-black, muted lilac and pale green;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal Nether Thread; Qi - Heaven Immortal. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Ancestral Thread Spindle.

Authored Chixia cast: Mo Shouxin, Cen Lanyin, Mo Yun, Tan Jiu. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Its strongest ancestor seeks Rebirth Nirvana. The sect has no special exemption from Netherworld True Venerable’s authority or automatic knowledge of ascension’s full mechanism. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. The apparent reply now heard from the spindle is an old instruction replayed by a worn return loop. Identical pauses and a broken return groove prove no new immortal message was received. 

Mo Shouxin is the Great Perfection Dao Integration resident ancestor. Cen Lanyin suspects repetition in the spindle without yet proving the worn loop. Mo Yun and Tan Jiu have their own pursuits and no automatic knowledge of the defect.
Named immortal forebear: True Immortal Nether Thread. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Inverse Puppet Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Prepared puppet vessels let cultivators apply their attained art through a deliberately maintained connection.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Great Perfection Dao Integration on the Qi path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Heavenly Alliance. Seat: Inverse Mountain, Inverted Mountain Country, Chixia Realm.

Attire: ivory, ink-blue and copper;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal of the Inverted Hand; Qi - Heaven Immortal. Body - No Cultivation. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: First Joint.

Authored Chixia cast: Yan Shou, Qiao Suyun, Wen Chi, Tian Su. These are selected representatives; use the named resident ancestor where now authored.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Original-body location and connection differ by method; loss has real consequences. Stored puppets make attacks costly but never add up automatically to a superior realm or grant infinite lives. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. The founder, True Immortal of the Inverted Hand, is a Heaven Immortal on the Qi path. This surviving finger-joint relic is the authentic anchor of the descent conspiracy. 

The inner workshop circle and resident ancestor are preparing the full descent of True Immortal of the Inverted Hand. See Chixia — Inverted Hand Descent for the fixed four nodes, vessel, relic, stages and interruption rules. Ancestral instruction is the public pretext. The intended full arrival will corrupt Chixia; the founder intends sovereignty over its transformed inhabitants.

Yan Shou is the Great Perfection Dao Integration resident ancestor and informed descent architect. Qiao Suyun knows a living presence is intended, but lacks the founder’s full instructions and understanding of realm conversion. Wen Chi believes the public teaching-vessel pretext. Tian Su has observed one receiving cavity and can discover the four-way match through actual comparison. Yan’s operated puppet is not a separate NPC or independent life.
Named immortal forebear: True Immortal of the Inverted Hand. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Ancient Battle Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Combat-developed bodies, inherited conditioning and proven force support leadership of the Earth Alliance.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Late Rebirth Nirvana on the Body path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Earth Alliance. Seat: Ancient Battle Citadel, Ancient Battle Mountains, Chixia Realm.

Attire: dark ochre, black iron and bone-white;

Ancestral lineage: Immortal Lord First Battle; Qi - No Cultivation. Body - Earth Lord. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: First Battle Plate.

Authored Earth Alliance cast: Shi Zongwu, Bao Sanniang, Shi Peng, Dai Chun. The sect or clan cast cultivates Body only; resident ancestors and ascended immortal forebears retain distinct established ranks.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Bloody Asura contests precedence. The strongest ancestor’s departure would alter the balance, but no automatic ascension deadline is active. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. The departed founder, now Earth Lord’s armour fragment is sealed. The resident Late Rebirth Nirvana ancestor remains mortal to immortals. 

Shi Zongwu is the Late Rebirth Nirvana resident ancestor. Bao Sanniang is the Middle Spirit Transformation instructor; Shi Peng and Dai Chun are adult peers. Bao and Luo Hongzhu have established professional respect, not automatic mutual knowledge of secrets.
Named immortal forebear: Immortal Lord First Battle. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Bloody Asura Clan
factions.basicInfo:
An Asura lineage guarding ancestral refinement, heirs and bloodline prestige.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Middle Rebirth Nirvana on the Body path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Earth Alliance. Seat: Asura Ancestral Fortress, Asura Highlands, Chixia Realm.

Attire: deep crimson, charcoal and dull gold;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal Ancestral Blood; Qi - No Cultivation. Body - Earth Immortal. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Ancestral Blood Stone.

Authored Earth Alliance cast: Luo Chishan, Luo Hongzhu, Luo Sheng, Luo Ailan. The sect or clan cast cultivates Body only; resident ancestors and ascended immortal forebears retain distinct established ranks.
Resident ancestor: Luo Zhan.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Accepts alliance obligations while refusing to treat its clan head as Ancient Battle’s disciple. Heirs compete over real resources, not automatic inherited superiority. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. Only an attenuated inherited refinement is currently accessible. Bloodline prestige does not compel an immortal answer. 

Luo Chishan is the active Late Dao Integration patriarch, distinct from the resident ancestor Luo Zhan. Luo Hongzhu, Luo Sheng and Luo Ailan are Asura relatives with independent ambitions; bloodline does not make each an equal in power.
Luo Zhan fills the previously uncast resident ancestor role; follow the dossier’s individual knowledge.
Named immortal forebear: True Immortal Ancestral Blood. Actual knowledge and contact follow that dossier; lineage grants no automatic rescue.

factions.name: Cold Phoenix Sect
factions.basicInfo:
Cold phoenix-derived bodily methods emphasize endurance and cultivated renewal without making all disciples phoenix-blooded.

Cultivation: strongest resident ancestor Middle Rebirth Nirvana on the Body path. This is the resident ceiling; active leaders, elders and younger cultivators have individual ranks.

Member of Earth Alliance. Seat: Cold Phoenix Palace, Frostfeather Mountains, Chixia Realm.

Attire: glacier-blue, white and pale silver;

Ancestral lineage: True Immortal Winter Marrow; Qi - No Cultivation. Body - Earth Immortal. Martial - No Cultivation. Separate from the unchanged resident ancestor. Ancestral treasure: Winter Marrow Vessel.

Authored Earth Alliance cast: Qin Xueyi, Han Zhaoxiu, Qin Yanshuang, He Song. The sect or clan cast cultivates Body only; resident ancestors and ascended immortal forebears retain distinct established ranks.
Resident ancestor: Qin Suxue.
factions.hiddenInfo:
Competes with Profound Yin over northern grounds and with Crimson Phoenix over claims concerning phoenix inheritances. Neither rival owns all relevant arts by its name. 

ANCESTRAL TRUTH. The immortal founder was a Body cultivator whose method drew on phoenix inheritance. This does not make every disciple a phoenix. 

Qin Xueyi is the active Middle Dao Integration mistress; Qin Suxue is the Middle Rebirth Nirvana resident ancestor. Han Zhaoxiu knows the cracked outlet and restricts treatment.
